# SiliconPhotonicsNetwork

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An on-chip or chip-to-chip network fabric built on silicon photonic waveguides, modulators, and detectors for optical data routing. Provides reconfigurable, high-throughput communication paths essential for dynamic topology mapping in TCC systems.
